episodes.title: The Things We Carry
episodes.summary: Haunted by his days as a mercenary, Lukas lives in the shadows, scraping a living as a waste picker. But when he witnesses a brutal crime, he's thrust back into a world of violence he thought he'd left behind.

episodes.title: No Safe Haven
episodes.summary: Phumza shatters Lukas and Neo's fragile refuge at the homeless shelter, unleashing tragedy, a child's desperate fight for survival, and igniting Lukas's hunger for vengeance.

episodes.title: Race Against Blood
episodes.summary: Lukas races to save a missing teenager from a deadly underground fighting ring, only to be reunited with a ghost from his past. A close army friend who isn't the man he used to be.

episodes.title: Nothing Left to Lose
episodes.summary: Betrayed and pushed to the edge, Lukas must summon every last ounce of his resolve to save a precious life.

episodes.title: Salt in the Wounds
episodes.summary: Having uncovered a deadly diamond-smuggling ring, Lukas must unravel a web of deceit from his past.

episodes.title: It Ends Here
episodes.summary: Trapped in a deadly set-up, Lukas faces a life-or-death showdown in the shadows of an old salt mine. The lives of everyone he loves is at stake.
